contentBody: **AI produces: "Unlock Seamless Nutrition for Modern Living." What should you do first?**
option.1: Publish it because it sounds professional
option.3: Check whether it is clear, specific and relevant to the target audience
option.4: Ask AI to make it longer
answerExplanation: The first check is clarity, specificity, and relevance. Publishing, puff words, or extra length do not fix a generic line.

contentBody: **Which is the strongest refinement of "Our snack contains 15g protein" for an office-working audience?**
option.1: Our product leverages advanced protein nutrition.
option.2: 15g protein to help you stay full through the afternoon.
answerExplanation: The revision keeps the proof and ties it to the office afternoon. The other lines add jargon without a customer outcome.

contentBody: **Why is human judgment still important after AI has generated and evaluated copy?**
option.3: Humans bring brand context, cultural understanding, strategy and real-world customer insight
option.4: AI can only write social-media captions
answerExplanation: AI can draft and critique lines. Brand context, culture, strategy, and customer insight still need a person.
